Status.note: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx) lists this unit as operating. The table lists plant 55694 with two gas turbines of 270.0 MW each and one steam turbine of 310.5 MW. Together that is 850.5 MW, a little under the 851.0 MW GEM shows. Start year 2006 is unchanged. No planned retirement date is listed. I found no retirement, mothballing or sale in the sources I checked.

monitor.note: A Power Engineering article from September 2023 (https://www.power-eng.com/gas/turbines/tva-to-study-carbon-capture-at-two-natural-gas-fired-plants/) says the two partners would invest 1.25 million dollars in a study of about one year. Searches of news and the TVA announcement trail found no results or follow-up. So the carbon capture box stays blank.
